t: Communication From The Netherlands Consulate-General, Dated November 30, 1935, Re Michael V. Masslow, Russian

pages.en:
CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 3833.

SHANGHAI, 30 November 1935 .

〔右上角印章及手写批注：MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / B. D. 7/2!! / 2 '12 3-〕

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Michael V. MASLOW has
applied for a visé for admission into the Netherlands Indies.

He is of Russian origin, and in possession of a passport issued
by the Tsingtao Municipal Government at Tsingtao on the 9th November
1935, No. 251220.

According to his passport he was born in Moscow on the 25th
December 1896.

He states to have been connected with Messrs. Zimmerman & Co.
Inc., 60 Chung Shan Road, Tsingtao, for the last two years as a
chemist, and intends to visit the Philippines and Java to study the
distillery business.

A visé for admission into the Philippines was issued to him
by the American Consulate in Shanghai on the 6th November 1935,
No. 10/1935-36.

He intends to leave on the Empress of Russia on the 3rd December.

I should be much obliged to you if you could let me know, if
possible, whether he is the same person who has been formerly con-
nected with the Centrosojus and whether he and the firm who recommends
him to me, still entertain relations with Soviet organisations.

I may add that although Maslow stated that he would only stay
in the Philippines for about two months his American visé was granted
for permanent residence.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕

Chinese Secretary.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

〔右下角手写批注：OS Makaroff〕

〔左下角手写批注：S 2. For attention / please. Jpg - 2 DEC 1935〕
pages.zh:
荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。
第 3833 号。

上海，1935年11月30日。

〔右上角印章及手写批注：工部局警务处 / 特科档案室 / B. D. 7/2!! / 2 '12 3-〕

先生：

谨此通知，Michael V. MASLOW 已申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

该人系俄裔，持有青岛市政府于1935年11月9日在青岛签发的护照，号码为 251220。

根据其护照记载，他于1896年12月25日出生于莫斯科。

他声称过去两年在青岛中山路60号的 Zimmerman & Co. Inc. 公司担任化学师，并打算前往菲律宾和爪哇考察酿酒业。

美国驻上海领事馆已于1935年11月6日向他签发了进入菲律宾的签证，号码为 10/1935-36。

他计划于12月3日乘坐“俄罗斯皇后号”（Empress of Russia）轮离境。

如蒙告知，据您所知，此人是否即为先前与 Centrosojus（苏联中央消费合作总社）有关联者，以及他和推荐他的商号是否仍与苏维埃组织保持联系，本人将不胜感激。

此外需补充说明的是，尽管 Maslow 声称仅在菲律宾停留约两个月，但其获得的美国签证却是永久居留性质。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔签名〕

中文秘书。

T. P. Givens 先生，
副总监，特科，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

〔右下角手写批注：OS Makaroff〕

〔左下角手写批注：S 2. 请予关注。Jpg - 1935年12月2日〕

CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL DE SUISSE
EN CHINE
**〔此处转录不清〕**

G.-XII L.- 54

Shanghai, January 4th 1936.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge the receipt
of your communications of December 3rd and 17th last
regarding the investigations made by your services
on Mr. N.V. Dolgikoff. I am much obliged for the in-
formation forwarded and wish to thank you for you
kind assistance in the matter.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
**〔签名〕**
SWISS CONSUL-GENERAL

To the Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
S h a n g h a i .
pages.zh:
瑞士驻中国总领事馆
**〔此处转录不清〕**

G.-XII L.- 54

上海，1936年1月4日。

先生：

谨此确认收到贵方去年12月3日及17日来函，内容涉及贵部门对 N.V. Dolgikoff 先生进行的调查。非常感谢转来的信息，并感谢阁下在此事上给予的善意协助。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
**〔签名〕**
瑞士总领事

致警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

D.
18 2 35

December 17 35.

Consul General for Switzerland,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No. G.XI L.3068 dated November 30, 1935, and to inform
you that Nicholas Vladimirovitch Dolgikoff, a Russian,
is at present in the French Municipal Gaol serving a
term of 50 days' imprisonment which was imposed upon
him on November 4, 1935, for fraud.

Dolgikoff has no fixed abode. No. 294 Tongshan
Road, which he gave as an address, is occupied by the
Hsui Kong(瑞康) Chinese Pawn Shop, and there is no
foreigner living there.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) **〔此处转录不清〕**
Acting Commissioner of Police.

D.
18 2 35

1935年12月17日。

致瑞士驻上海总领事，
上海。

先生：

谨此回复阁下1935年11月30日第 G.XI L.3068 号来函，并告知，俄国人 Nicholas Vladimirovitch Dolgikoff 目前正在法公董局监狱服刑，刑期50天，系因诈骗罪于1935年11月4日被判处。

Dolgikoff 无固定住所。其所提供的地址同山路294号现为瑞康（Hsui Kong）当铺所占用，并无外侨居住于此。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

(签署) **〔此处转录不清〕**
代理警务处处长。
